title: OpenXR: With eye-tracked foveated rendering, everything becomes low resolution with MSAA, unless Glow or FXAA is enabled
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in Godot 4.6-dev6 ### System information Samsung Galaxy XR - Android - Vulkan Mobile renderer ### Issue description On Samsung Galaxy XR: - With MSAA only, everything renders fine - With eye-tracked foveated rendering only, everything renders fine - But with both MSAA and eye-tracked foveation, it renders as if the FDM had the value for the lowest density everywhere (so, everything is very low res) However, if I enable Glow or FXAA (either of which makes Godot switch away from doing subpasses), then everything renders fine again - it even looks like both MSAA and the eye-tracked foveated rendering are working. Here a screenshot when it looks correct (I was looking at the center of the panel where it says "Foveation Profile", so it should be high resolution there, and low resolution everywhere else - which is what the screenshot shows): And, here is when Glow is disabled, and everything goes low resolution: The only other device I have that supports eye-tracked foveated rendering is the Quest Pro, and, interestingly, it doesn't seem to have this problem. The foveation seems to work correctly regardless of if glow is enabled or not. Anyway, glow is not the fastest on mobile hardware, so we usually recommend for folks to disable it. Which means the recommended configuration (ie foveation enabled, MSAA enabled, glow disabled) is the one that's broken. (FYI, eye-tracked foveated rendering is new in Godot 4.6 - it was added in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/112888) ### Steps to reproduce Probably easiest to use the MRP attached below However, the steps are something like: - Setup an OpenXR project for a standalone Android-based headset in the usual way - Set the "Foveation Level" to "High", and enable the "Eye Gaze Interaction" extension (Android XR seems to require it for eye-tracked foveated rendering, even though Meta Quest doesn't) - Set the VRS mode to "XR" - Enable MSAA 2x - Add a WorldEnvironment node to your scene, with an Environment that has Glow disabled - Run on the Samsung Galaxy XR and see the super low resolution! ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Here's an MRP: [meta-foveation-sample.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24042443/meta-foveation-sample.zip) It needs godot_openxr_vendors v4.2.2, which isn't in the ZIP to save space, but you can download it via the asset library. It's reproducible with Godot 4.6-dev6
